verse.verse_2: when the stars are thrown down,
verse.verse_3: and the mountains have been taken,
verse.verse_4: when the pregnant camels are neglected,
verse.verse_5: when the savage beasts are gathered
verse.verse_6: when the seas are set boiling,
verse.verse_7: when the souls are coupled (to their body),
verse.verse_8: when the buried female infant is asked
verse.verse_9: for what crime she was slain,
verse.verse_14: then, each soul shall know what it has produced.
verse.verse_15: Rather, I swear by the returning
verse.verse_17: by the night when it approaches
verse.verse_18: and the morning when it extends,
verse.verse_19: it is indeed the word of an Honorable Messenger,
verse.verse_20: of power, given a rank by the Owner of the Throne
verse.verse_23: in truth he saw him (Gabriel) on the clear horizon,
verse.verse_24: he is not grudging of the Unseen.
verse.verse_25: Nor is this the word of a stoned satan.
verse.verse_27: This is nothing but a Reminder to the worlds,
verse.verse_28: for whosoever of you would go straight,
verse.verse_29: but you shall not, unless Allah wills, the Lord of all the Worlds.
